fg.note: 15.46:1 at worst surface (bg-elevated). Headings, active nav, prose emphasis.

fg-muted.note: 7.00:1 dark / 6.33:1 light at worst surface. Carries most body copy.

fg-subtle.note: FORBIDDEN FOR TEXT. Measures 3.55:1 dark / 3.17:1 light at worst surface. Non-text decoration only.

fg-faint.note: FORBIDDEN FOR TEXT at any size. ~2:1. Non-informational marks only.

border.note: Set globally in @layer base, so a bare `border` utility is already the right colour.

border-strong.note: Hover and focus only. Never at rest.

syn-string.note: 7.41:1 at worst surface. Also used for numbers.

syn-comment.note: Raised from the spec's #5A5A5A, which measured 2.87:1 and failed AA. Now 4.84:1. The only italic on the site.

syn-punctuation.note: Light theme raised from #8A8A8A to #6E6E6E, which measured 3.17:1 and failed AA.

display.purpose: The landing hero. Appears exactly once on the entire site.

headline.purpose: Page title on every content page.

subtitle.purpose: h3. The deepest heading level used.

body.purpose: All prose, capped at a 720px measure (~75 characters).

nav.purpose: Sidebar, table of contents, footer links, tab triggers.

code.purpose: Block code. Inline code is 0.9em, the one relative size on the site.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, numbered section indices, filename bars, version badge. Mono, uppercase.

extensions.shadowPolicy: No shadows. Depth is tonal (bg -> bg-subtle -> bg-elevated) plus 1px hairlines. box-shadow is not part of this system, and a 1px border paired with a soft wide shadow is prohibited outright.

motion.name: colour-transition
motion.purpose: Every hover and focus state. The default.

motion.name: reduced-motion-guard
motion.purpose: One global guard covers the whole site. Per-component duplicates are prohibited.

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Version badge appears; hero CTAs move beside the install command.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar becomes a sticky column instead of a drawer; landing margin grid engages.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Table of contents appears as a third column.

containers.name: toc
containers.purpose: On-this-page column, and the landing grid's margin column.

containers.name: shell
containers.purpose: Outer width shared by the header, the docs shell, and the landing page.

components.css: .ds-code { position: relative; margin: 24px 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--border-c, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); border-radius: 6px; background: var(--bg-subtle, #111111); } .ds-code__bar { padding: 8px 16px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-c, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); color: var(--fg-muted, #A1A1A1); font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-code__copy { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px; display: grid; place-items: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--border-c, rgba(255,255,255,0.08)); border-radius: 4px; background: var(--bg-subtle, #111111); color: var(--fg-muted, #A1A1A1); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease-out, border-color 150ms ease-out, opacity 150ms ease-out; } @media (pointer: fine) { .ds-code__copy { opacity: 0; } } .ds-code:hover .ds-code__copy, .ds-code__copy:focus-visible { opacity: 1; } .ds-code__copy:hover { border-color: var(--border-strong, rgba(255,255,255,0.14)); color: var(--fg, #EDEDED); } .ds-code__pre { margin: 0; overflow-x: auto; padding: 16px; color: var(--fg, #EDEDED); font-family: 'Geist Mono Variable', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.6; } .ds-syn-kw { color: var(--syn-keyword, #8AA9C9); } .ds-syn-cm { color: var(--syn-comment, #848484); font-style: italic; }

narrative.northStar: Infrastructure Documentation Written By Someone With Taste
narrative.overview:
This is a reference manual for a library that makes error responses boring on purpose. The design makes the same argument about itself. There is no chromatic accent anywhere in the interface — not one. Every level of hierarchy is produced by a nine-step neutral ramp and by 1px hairlines, and the reader's attention is therefore never spent on the chrome. It is spent on the JSON payload, the classifier priority table, the one warning that will save them an afternoon.

The system is dark-first because of where it gets read: a developer with an editor open on one side and this on the other, at whatever hour the exception showed up. Light is a genuine second theme, not an afterthought — both are held to the same contrast floor, and neither was designed by inverting the other.

What it rejects: the startup landing page. No hero metric, no gradient mesh, no animated background, no testimonials, no logo wall, no card with a soft wide shadow. Sections are separated by space rather than by horizontal rules; <hr> appears essentially never. Where a lesser system would reach for a coloured pill to show state, this one brightens a hairline.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome by doctrine. Zero chromatic accent in the UI.
Hairlines over fills. 1px borders are the primary structural device.
Two themes, one set of utilities. No dark: variant exists in the codebase.
Restricted scales. Nine spacing steps, three radii, nine type roles. Nothing else.
Quiet motion. 150ms colour transitions, and nothing that moves on its own.

rules.name: The No Accent Rule
rules.body: There is no chromatic accent colour in the UI. Not for primary actions, not for the active nav item, not for focus, not for callout variants. If a change needs colour to read, the change is wrong. Rework it with weight, hairline strength, or space.

rules.name: The Text Floor Rule
rules.body: fg-subtle and fg-faint are measured below 4.5:1 in both themes and are prohibited for text of any size. Body copy and labels use fg or fg-muted, full stop. Every syntax token is held to the same 4.5:1 floor against bg-elevated, the worst-case surface.

rules.name: The Hairline-As-State Rule
rules.body: State lives in the border, not in a fill. The active sidebar item promotes its own left rule from border to fg. The selected tab promotes its bottom rule. No background pill, no tinted row, anywhere.

rules.name: The One Display Rule
rules.body: 44px appears once, in the landing hero, and nowhere else. Nothing on any other page goes above 30px. Resist scaling anything up to create emphasis.

rules.name: The No Bold Body Rule
rules.body: Weight reaches 600 only for headings. Emphasis inside prose is expressed as fg against fg-muted — never by bolding a word, never by enlarging it.

rules.name: The One Italic Rule
rules.body: Code comments are italic. Nothing else on the site is italic, which is why Geist Mono's real italic face is loaded and Geist Sans' is not.

rules.name: The No Shadow Rule
rules.body: box-shadow is not part of this system. A 1px border plus a soft wide shadow on the same element — the ghost-card pattern — is prohibited outright. If an element needs to separate from the page, move it one tonal step and give it a hairline.

rules.name: The Blur Has A Job Rule
rules.body: backdrop-filter appears only where content passes behind the element. It is never decoration.

dos: Do express every level of hierarchy with the neutral ramp, hairline weight, and space.
Do promote a hairline from border to border-strong on hover, and to fg for active state.
Do keep body copy and labels on fg or fg-muted, which are the only text-safe foreground tokens.
Do hold every colour pair to 4.5:1 against bg-elevated, the worst-case surface, in both themes.
Do restrict spacing to the nine steps 1 2 3 4 6 8 12 16 24 (4-96px) and radii to 4/6/8px.
Do put the standard focus ring — focus-visible:outline-2 outline-offset-2 outline-fg — on every interactive element, including links generated from markdown.
Do give body-prose links a persistent hairline underline that strengthens on hover. With no colour cue available, a link indistinguishable from body text until hover fails WCAG.
Do add a theme token when reaching for an arbitrary value. max-w-[720px] was wrong; --container-content was the fix.
donts: Don't introduce a chromatic accent colour for any UI purpose. This is the locked constraint.
Don't distinguish a link by colour. Underline is the only signal.
Don't use fg-subtle or fg-faint for text at any size. Both measure below 4.5:1.
Don't write a dark: colour variant. The @theme inline mapping resolves both themes from one set of utilities; dark: is admissible only for a genuine structural difference.
Don't use @apply outside @layer base. A repeated pattern becomes a Svelte component, not an @apply bundle.
Don't use an arbitrary value. The sole sanctioned exception on the entire site is inline code at text-[0.9em], which must scale relative to its parent.
Don't add a box-shadow, and never pair a 1px border with a soft wide shadow on the same element.
Don't build a startup landing page: no hero metric, no gradient mesh, no animated background, no testimonials, no logo wall.
Don't convey a callout's variant with a coloured background or border. Icon plus a 1px left rule, with the variant name exposed to screen readers so meaning never rests on the icon alone.
Don't hand-roll a second prefers-reduced-motion guard. One global guard exists; per-component duplicates are noise.
Don't extend the numbered-marker motif to lists or sections that are not genuinely a sequence.

Don't make a heading out of something that labels navigation. Sidebar, TOC and footer labels are paragraphs tied to their lists with aria-labelledby; as headings they sat above the page's own h1 in the outline.
